title: Sensor Calibration Drift
scenario: Find sensors that have shown a monotonic increase in temperature readings for 7 consecutive measurements.
tableSchema: weather_data (sensor_id INT, reading_date DATE, temp_c NUMERIC)
hint: Use LAG() to compare current with previous 6 readings.
correctQuery: SELECT DISTINCT sensor_id FROM (SELECT sensor_id, temp_c, LAG(temp_c, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY sensor_id ORDER BY reading_date) as l1, LAG(temp_c, 2) OVER(PARTITION BY sensor_id ORDER BY reading_date) as l2, LAG(temp_c, 3) OVER(PARTITION BY sensor_id ORDER BY reading_date) as l3, LAG(temp_c, 4) OVER(PARTITION BY sensor_id ORDER BY reading_date) as l4, LAG(temp_c, 5) OVER(PARTITION BY sensor_id ORDER BY reading_date) as l5, LAG(temp_c, 6) OVER(PARTITION BY sensor_id ORDER BY reading_date) as l6 FROM weather_data) t WHERE temp_c > l1 AND l1 > l2 AND l2 > l3 AND l3 > l4 AND l4 > l5 AND l5 > l6;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE weather_data (sensor_id INT, reading_date DATE, temp_c NUMERIC);
